purpose: Fixed adjudication corpus for the Experience hard-gate semantic boundary. Every case is checked against both enforcement layers: the Python runner (scripts/scoring_protocol/experience_runner.py) and the Dashboard import boundary (src/lib/experienceScoringPolicy.ts). The two must agree on every case.
coverageBoundary: These layers are mechanical. They bind a decision to exact source text, a recognized absolute-bar cue, and an inventory comparison, and they refuse the excluded requirement categories. They cannot judge whether a phrasing is genuinely absolute or whether prose is substantive — the `notMechanicallyEnforced` cases record exactly where the prompt is the only thing standing between a bad phrasing and a zero. Those cases are the argument for running a real model canary before the next bulk batch.

expectations.reject: must be refused; `rejectLabel` names the excluded category when the refusal is a category exclusion
expectations.notMechanicallyEnforced: passes both mechanical layers today; only the prompt prevents it

cases.name: positive control — explicit years minimum
cases.requirement: Ten years of enterprise medical device sales experience
cases.jdQuote: Minimum of 10 years of enterprise medical device sales experience is required.
cases.inventoryComparison: The evidence inventory documents six years of device sales, which is below the stated ten-year minimum.

cases.name: positive control — required industry experience
cases.requirement: Experience selling into regulated utility markets
cases.jdQuote: Candidates must have at least 5 years selling into regulated utility markets.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory records no utility-market selling of any duration; the requirement is absent entirely.

cases.name: positive control — role-defining credential
cases.jdQuote: An active RN license is required to perform clinical evaluations.
cases.inventoryComparison: No nursing licensure appears anywhere in the evidence inventory.

cases.name: positive control — experience floor whose quote also mentions travel and duties
cases.requirement: Field sales experience in industrial automation
cases.jdQuote: Requires 8+ years of field sales experience in industrial automation; you will travel up to 50%.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory shows no industrial automation field sales; that experience is absent.

cases.name: citizenship
cases.jdQuote: US citizenship is required for this federal contract role.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory contains no evidence of citizenship status.

cases.name: citizenship disguised as substantive experience — caught by the quote scan
cases.jdQuote: Must have US citizenship to support this federal program.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory does not evidence federal program delivery of any kind.

cases.name: work authorization
cases.jdQuote: Applicants must have work authorization; we do not offer visa sponsorship.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory does not establish work authorization status.

cases.name: security clearance
cases.jdQuote: An active security clearance is required at time of hire.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory shows no clearance of any level.

cases.name: lifting and physical demands
cases.requirement: Ability to lift and carry 50 pounds
cases.jdQuote: Must have the ability to lift and carry 50 pounds regularly.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory does not document lifting capacity.

cases.name: loading and unloading — the reviewed historical phrasing miss
cases.requirement: Loading and unloading motorcycles at dealer events
cases.jdQuote: Requires loading and unloading motorcycles at dealer events.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory is silent on motorcycle handling; no such evidence exists.

cases.requirement: Excellent presentation skills and comfort with upper management
cases.jdQuote: Must have excellent presentation skills and be comfortable with upper management.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory does not rate presentation ability, so the evidence is absent.

cases.jdQuote: You will be responsible for maintaining the CRM pipeline; CRM fluency is required.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory does not describe daily CRM pipeline maintenance.

cases.name: preferred qualification
cases.requirement: Preferred: MBA or equivalent graduate degree
cases.jdQuote: An MBA is preferred and is required for the senior band.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory records no graduate degree; that credential is absent.

cases.name: relocation
cases.jdQuote: Must have a willingness to relocate to Dallas within 90 days.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory contains no relocation commitment evidence.

cases.name: category outside the allowed enum
cases.jdQuote: Must have 5 years of executive-facing experience.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory does not evidence executive-facing work.

cases.name: quote does not appear in the job description
cases.jdQuote: Requires 5 years of enterprise SaaS renewal ownership.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory shows no renewal ownership; that experience is absent.

cases.name: no absolute-bar cue anywhere in the quote
cases.jdQuote: Sales enablement exposure is helpful in this role.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory does not evidence sales enablement work.

cases.name: inventory comparison too short to be a comparison
cases.jdQuote: Requires 5 years of enterprise SaaS renewal ownership.
cases.inventoryComparison: Not in evidence.

cases.name: descriptive range reads as a numeric floor
cases.why: The cue matcher recognizes any `N years` token, so `2-3 years` satisfies it. Only the prompt's instruction that a stated range is a target rather than a minimum keeps this out of the unmet list.
cases.requirement: Two to three years in sales enablement
cases.jdQuote: 2-3 years in sales enablement.
cases.inventoryComparison: The inventory shows one year of sales enablement, below the stated range.

cases.name: vague inventory comparison that clears the length floor
cases.why: The comparison check is structural — length, an inventory reference, and a negation. Padded boilerplate satisfies all three without actually comparing anything.
cases.jdQuote: Requires 5 years of enterprise SaaS renewal ownership.
cases.inventoryComparison: This was not found anywhere in the supplied evidence inventory.
